Every run is sealed: hashes bind what was read to what was written

{ "format_version":
    "artifact-review-run/v1",
  "status": "completed",
  "inputs": {
    "snapshot/paper/paper.pdf":
      "999e3d81…" },
  "stages": {
    "artifact_checks": "completed",
    "paper_review": "not-requested",
    "reproduction": "not-requested" },
  "outputs": {
    "judge.json": "<sha256>",
    "review-draft.md": "<sha256>" } }
  • The input artifact is never modified, and a run is never overwritten
  • Every stage reports its status: completed, unavailable, not-run, or not-requested
  • Anyone can re-hash a run and verify it without trusting the tool
  • A human-in-the-loop layer reads the run and never edits it
